SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND DATE(order_date) = #{targetDate} ), 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND DATE(order_date) = #{targetDate} ), 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(( SELECT r.name FROM order_menu om JOIN recipe r ON om.recipe_code = r.recipe_code JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = om.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) = #{targetDate} GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(om.qty) DESC LIMIT 1 ), 'N/A') AS popular_menu, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND MONTH(order_date) = MONTH(#{targetDate}) AND YEAR(order_date) = YEAR(#{targetDate}) ), 0) AS monthly_cumulative_sales

SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND DATE(order_date) = #{targetDate} ), 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND DATE(order_date) = #{targetDate} ), 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(( SELECT r.name FROM order_menu om JOIN recipe r ON om.recipe_code = r.recipe_code JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = om.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) = #{targetDate} GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(om.qty) DESC LIMIT 1 ), 'N/A') AS popular_menu, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND MONTH(order_date) = MONTH(#{targetDate}) AND YEAR(order_date) = YEAR(#{targetDate}) ), 0) AS monthly_cumulative_sales
SELECT category_id AS category_id, name FROM main_category WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY category_id;
SELECT sub_category_code AS sub_category_code, name FROM sub_category WHERE main_category_id = #{mainCategoryId} ORDER BY sub_category_code;

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(om.qty) DESC) AS `rank`, r.name AS menu_name, SUM(om.qty) AS quantity, SUM(om.line_total_amount) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id JOIN recipe r ON om.recipe_code = r.recipe_code WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) = #{targetDate} AND r.category_id = #{categoryId} GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY `rank`

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(om.qty) DESC) AS `rank`, b.name AS branch_name, SUM(om.qty) AS quantity, SUM(om.line_total_amount) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_menu om ON o.order_id = om.order_id JOIN branch b ON o.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND DATE(o.order_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND om.recipe_code = #{recipeCode} GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY `rank`
